title: Scientific Notation Converter
h1: Scientific Notation Converter — Standard and E Notation
description: Convert a number to scientific notation or expand scientific notation into a plain decimal. Useful for science homework and data cleanup.
intro: Enter a plain number or a value such as 6.02e23. The converter shows scientific notation, normalized coefficient and the expanded decimal when it fits.
blurb: Convert numbers to and from scientific notation without leaving the browser.
howItWorks: Enter a decimal number or E notation such as 1.5e-7.
Set how many significant digits the scientific form should keep.
Press Convert to see the coefficient, exponent and both written forms.
examples: 6022 followed by zeros becomes 6.022 × 10^23 at 4 significant digits.

faq.a: Plain decimals and JavaScript-style E notation are accepted. Commas and spaces are ignored.

faq.q: Why might the expanded form be omitted?
faq.a: Extremely large or small exponents are kept in scientific form so the page does not print thousands of zeros.
